overlaps.rationale: An account balance is the current amount of money in an account, whereas a bank account is the account itself.
An account balance is an amount; a bank statement is a record of account transactions.
An account balance is the money amount currently held; an account holder is the person registered to the account.
Malaysian baki overlaps lexically with the candidate's baki akaun, but change returned is money due after payment, distinct from a bank account balance.
